description: withdraw does check-then-update without a transaction or row lock: two concurrent withdrawals both pass the balance check and overdraw the wallet
auditLog(...) is fire-and-forget: not awaited and no .catch, so a rejected insert is an unhandled rejection and the audit entry can be silently lost
